arxiv-2012-13512.title: Some comparisons of Blanchfield pairings and cohomology pairings of knots
arxiv-2012-13512.description: Abstract We study some comparison between a bilinear cohomology pairing in local coefficients and the Blanchfield pairing of a knot. We show that the former pairing is an S S -equivalent invariant, and give a criterion to a relation between the two pairings.

The 40m radio telescope at Yebes Observatory is operated by t

arxiv-2209-07872.title: Plasma dynamics at the Schwinger limit and beyond
arxiv-2209-07872.creator: Gert Brodin, Haidar Al-Naseri, Jens Zamanian, Greger Torgrimsson, Bengt Eliasson
arxiv-2209-07872.description: Abstract Strong field physics close to or above the Schwinger limit are typically studied with vacuum as initial condition, or by considering test particle dynamics. However, with a plasma present initially, quantum relativistic mechanisms such as Schwinger pair-creation are complemented by classical plasma nonlinearities.

arxiv-2308-02233.title: Self-Normalizing Neural Network, Enabling One Shot Transfer Learning for Modeling EDFA Wavelength Dependent Gain
arxiv-2308-02233.creator: Agastya Raj *, (1), Zehao Wang (2), Frank Slyne (1), Tingjun Chen (2), Dan Kilper (1), Marco Ruffini (1)
arxiv-2308-02233.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The gain spectrum of an EDFA ( EDFA ) has a complex dependence on channel loading, pump power, and operating mode, making accurate modeling difficult to achieve. Recently, ML ( ML ) techniques such as NN have been used to build EDFA gain models [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2404-03202.title: OmniGS: Fast Radiance Field Reconstruction using Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2404-03202.creator: Longwei Li, Huajian Huang, Sai-Kit Yeung, Hui Cheng
arxiv-2404-03202.description: Abstract Photorealistic reconstruction relying on 3D Gaussian Splatting has shown promising potential in various domains. However, the current 3D Gaussian Splatting system only supports radiance field reconstruction using undistorted perspective images. In this paper, we present OmniGS, a novel omnidirectional Gaussian splatting system, to take advantage of omnidirectional images for fast radiance field reconstruction.

arxiv-2411-01255.title: Revisit Many-body Interaction Heat Current and Thermal Conductivity Calculation in Moment Tensor Potential/LAMMPS Interface
arxiv-2411-01255.creator: Siu Ting Tai, Chen Wang, Ruihuan Cheng, Yue Chen
arxiv-2411-01255.description: Abstract The definition of heat current operator for systems for non-pairwise additive interactions and its impact on related lattice thermal conductivity ( κ L \kappa_{L} ) via molecular dynamics simulation (MD) are ambiguous and controversial when migrating from conventional empirical potential models to machine learning potential (MLP) models.

arxiv-2412-11684.title: Runtime Analysis for Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms in Unbounded Integer Spaces
arxiv-2412-11684.creator: Benjamin Doerr, Martin S. Krejca, Günter Rudolph
arxiv-2412-11684.description: Abstract Randomized search heuristics have been applied successfully to a plethora of problems. This success is complemented by a large body of theoretical results. Unfortunately, the vast majority of these results regard problems with binary or continuous decision variables – the theoretical analysis of randomized search heuristics for unbounded integer domains is almost nonexistent.

arxiv-2502-11912.title: Uncovering the atomic structure of substitutional platinum dopants in MoS 2 with single-sideband ptychography
arxiv-2502-11912.creator: David Lamprecht, Anna Benzer, Manuel Längle, Mate Capin, Clemens Mangler, Toma Susi, Lado Filipovic, Jani Kotakoski
arxiv-2502-11912.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Lamprecht, Anna Benzer, Manuel Längle, Mate Capin, Clemens Mangler, Toma Susi, Lado Filipovic, Jani Kotakoski. We substitute individual Pt atoms into monolayer MoS 2 \text{MoS}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} and study the resulting atomic structures with single-sideband ptychography (SSB) supported by ab initio simulations. We demonstrate that while high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) imaging provides excellent Z -contrast, distinguishing some defect types such as single and double sulfur vacancies remains challenging due to their low relative contrast difference.

arxiv-2503-04869.title: Label Distribution Learning-Enhanced Dual-KNN for Text Classification
arxiv-2503-04869.creator: Bo Yuan, Yulin Chen, Zhen Tan, Wang Jinyan, Huan Liu, Yin Zhang
arxiv-2503-04869.description: Abstract Many text classification methods usually introduce external information (e.g., label descriptions and knowledge bases) to improve the classification performance. Compared to external information, some internal information generated by the model itself during training, like text embeddings and predicted label probability distributions, are exploited poorly when predicting the outcomes of some texts.

arxiv-2505-15788.title: Fair Supervised Learning Through Constraints on Smooth Nonconvex Unfairness-Measure Surrogates
arxiv-2505-15788.creator: Zahra Khatti, Daniel P. Robinson, Frank E. Curtis
arxiv-2505-15788.description: Abstract A new strategy for fair supervised machine learning is proposed. The main advantages of the proposed strategy as compared to others in the literature are as follows. (a) We introduce a new smooth nonconvex surrogate to approximate the Heaviside functions involved in discontinuous unfairness measures.

arxiv-2506-18627.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Inverse Design in Photonic Integrated Circuits
arxiv-2506-18627.creator: Yannik Mahlau, Maximilian Schier, Christoph Reinders, Frederik Schubert, Marco Bügling, Bodo Rosenhahn
arxiv-2506-18627.description: Abstract Inverse design of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) has traditionally relied on gradient-based optimization. However, this approach is prone to end up in local minima, which results in suboptimal design functionality. As interest in PICs increases due to their potential for addressing modern hardware demands through optical computing, more adaptive optimization algorithms are needed.

arxiv-2506-22042.title: A note on Sobolev-Lorentz Capacity and Hausdorff measure Thanks: The author was supported by the grant GAČR P201/24-10505S and Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport of the Czech Republic grant number LL2105 CONTACT
arxiv-2506-22042.creator: Daniel Campbell
arxiv-2506-22042.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Daniel Campbell. In this paper we give an elementary proof that sets of zero p , 1 p,1 -Sobolev-Lorentz capacity are ℋ n − p \mathcal{H}^{n-p} -null sets independently of non-linear potential theory. We further show that there exists a set of Sobolev-Lorentz- ( p , 1 ) (p,1) capacity equal zero with Hausdorff dimension equal n − p n-p . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 31C40, 46E35, 46E30 1.

arxiv-2512-18066.title: Deep Gaussian Processes with Gradients
arxiv-2512-18066.creator: Annie S. Booth
arxiv-2512-18066.description: Abstract Deep Gaussian processes (DGPs) are popular surrogate models for complex nonstationary computer experiments. DGPs use one or more latent Gaussian processes (GPs) to warp the input space into a plausibly stationary regime, then use typical GP regression on the warped domain.

pmc-11727918.title: The Investigation of Graphene Oxide-Enhanced Hybrid Slurry Preparation and Its Polishing Characteristic on CVD Single Crystal Diamond
pmc-11727918.creator: Zixuan Wang, Yang Zhao, Jie Yao, Tianbiao Yu, Sheng Qu, Jun Zhao
pmc-11727918.description: As an environment-friendly material, graphene oxide nanosheet can effectively improve the polishing surface quality of single crystal diamond workpieces. However, the lubricating and chemical effects of graphene oxide nanosheets have an uncertain impact on the polishing material removal rate. In this paper, the graphene oxide-enhanced hybrid slurry was prepared with good stability.

pmc-12512704.title: The combination of anti-PD-1 antibodies, trastuzumab and chemotherapy may improve the outcome of some patients with HER2-positive alpha-fetoprotein-producing gastric cancer: a retrospective real-world analysis from a single center
pmc-12512704.creator: Shaohua Ge, Feixue Wang, Hongli Li, Yuchong Yang, Le Zhang, Jingjing Duan, Ming Bai, Rui Liu, Tao Ning, Xia Wang, Zhi Ji, Yansha Sun, Ting Deng
pmc-12512704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPatients with alpha-fetoprotein-producing gastric cancer (AFPGC) characterized with elevated serum AFP levels have received increased interest because of their aggressive behavior and poor prognosis. AFPGC patients who are HER2 positive are even poorer.MethodsA single-center retrospective real-world analysis was conducted in patients with histologically confirmed gastric cancer, an AFP level > 7 ng/ml and who were pathologically HER2 positive at Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute. Clinical characteristics, treatments and survival were recorded. The last follow-up date was February 10, 2023.

pmc-12753107.title: Chinese Altay sheep adapt to seasonal fluctuations in forage nutrients by changing physiological status and rumen microbial community structure
pmc-12753107.creator: Mingyu Ma, Peng Zhang, Zhenzi Xu, Shu Li, Sijin Li, Qicheng Lu, Wenju Zhang, Yuanyaun Li
pmc-12753107.description: IntroductionAs the primary nutritional source for grazing livestock, natural forage directly influences changes in physiological status and rumen microbial community structure owing to seasonal variations in its nutritional composition. However, the physiological and rumen microbial community adaptations of Chinese Altay sheep in response to seasonal variations in forage nutrition remain unclear.

pmc-12978898.title: Perceptions and Attitudes of Medical Students Toward the Integration of Large Language Models in Medical Education: Cross-Sectional Survey in China
pmc-12978898.creator: Cheng Zhao, Weiqian Yan, Long Wang, Jing Wu, Herve Pasteur Ndikuriyo, Renhe Yu
pmc-12978898.description: BackgroundAlthough artificial intelligence (AI) is being rapidly integrated into medical education, insights from medical students, particularly in the Chinese context, remain limited.ObjectiveThis study was designed to explore Chinese medical students’ perceptions of and attitudes toward the integration of AI into medical education, as well as the factors that may influence their perspectives.

pmc-13129251.title: How Dietary Restrictions Can Lead to Being Caught in a Negative Spiral: A Qualitative Study of Patients' Experiences After Orthognathic Surgery
pmc-13129251.creator: Eva Dorby Vest Hansen, Line Lundell Andreasen, Ulrik Sundberg Simonsen, Charlotte Nielsen
pmc-13129251.description: AimThe purpose of this qualitative study was to explore patients' experiences following orthognathic surgery with a focus on dietary management.MethodsTo gain in‐depth knowledge of patients' postoperative dietary management, a phenomenological−hermeneutic approach was applied, in which data were collected through individual semi‐structured telephone interviews.

pmc-13377162.title: Periprocedural allergy evaluation is safe and effective to guide subsequent anesthesia administration
pmc-13377162.creator: Jane Liao, Ami Belmont, Chang Su, Lucia You, Jessica Oh, Moeun Son, Jason H Kwah

pmc-13382584.title: Oncolytic virotherapy with chimeric rVSV-NDV causes tumor-specific immunity in a DC-activation-dependent manner
pmc-13382584.creator: Lorenz Hanesch, Nina Hartmann, Sonja Glauß, Tianle Feng, Jennifer Altomonte
pmc-13382584.description: In recent years, activation of the immune system has been recognized as a key mechanism in supporting the therapeutic outcome of oncolytic virotherapy for cancer. Most studies have focused on T cells in the characterization of immune responses to therapy; however, the role of dendritic cells (DCs) in priming these cytotoxic T cell responses has been far less explored.

pmc-13435442.title: tVNS and obesity-related inflammation: a prospective sham-controlled randomized crossover study protocol
pmc-13435442.creator: Luisa Kaluza, Anne Kühnel, Ernesto Picòn-Galindo, Mona Hergenröther, Hesham Alkhateeb, Simon Michalski, Dalila Juliana Silva Ribeiro, Susanne V. Schmidt, Dagmar Wachten, Nils B. Kroemer
pmc-13435442.description: BackgroundOverweight and obesity are characterized by detrimental effects on energy metabolism and an increase in adipose tissue, leading to chronic low-grade inflammation. This metaflammation may contribute to mental symptoms, such as reduced mood and motivation. Inflammatory processes are modulated by the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway (CAIP) that can be targeted with vagus nerve stimulation (VNS).

pmc-13540265.title: Pressure‐Derived Right Ventricular Ejection Fraction During Initial Dual Combination Therapy in Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
pmc-13540265.creator: Tharsiga Kanagasingam, Jonas Lund, Christoph R. Sinning, Gunnar K. Lund, Hans Klose, Lars Harbaum
pmc-13540265.description: In patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension, pressure‐based right ventricular ejection fraction (RVEF) estimated from routine right heart catheterisation correlated with RVEF from magnetic resonance imaging. A framework combining Weibull distribution‐derived theoretical isovolumic pressure and time‐varying elastance‐derived end‐systolic pressure showed the closest correlation and was responsive to initial oral combination therapy.

pmc-13565291.title: Dietary Supplementation with Multispecies Probiotic Fermented Broth Improves Nutrient Digestibility and Carcass Traits While Modulating the Cecal Microbiota and Thigh Muscle Fatty Acid Profile in Yellow-Feathered Broilers
pmc-13565291.creator: Haiqing Gan, Youping Tan, Dan Zhong, Sirui Li, Huange Xie, Xingguo Huang, Dun Deng, Qianglin Liu, Qiyu Tian, Lingyuan Yang
pmc-13565291.description: Simple SummaryMultispecies probiotic fermented broth (MPFB) is a liquid fermentation product containing probiotics and fermentation-derived bioactive compounds. This study showed that dietary supplementation with 4% MPFB improved nutrient digestibility, carcass traits, and intestinal morphology, altered the cecal microbial composition, and modified the thigh muscle fatty acid profile in 815-strain yellow-feathered broilers.

pmc-13591894.title: Survival prediction of 18F-FDG PET/CT in pediatric patients with recurrent neuroblastoma
pmc-13591894.creator: Wenfang Tang, Zhonglin Liang, Chao Li, Yafu Yin, Hui Wang, Jinglue Song, Suyun Chen
pmc-13591894.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeOur study aims to investigate the predictive potential of FDG PET/CT in pediatric patients with NB at the time of recurrence.MethodsPediatric patients with suspected recurrence of NB underwent FDG PET/CT were included in this retrospective study. The clinicopathological data, PET visual analysis data and semiquantitative values (maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of tumor, tumor-to-liver uptake ratio (TLR), metabolic tumor volume (MTV), total lesion glycolysis (TLG)), were analyzed.

uslaw-usc-t42-s7705e.title: 42 U.S.C. § 7705e — Post-earthquake investigations program
uslaw-usc-t42-s7705e.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s7705e.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 86 (Earthquake Hazards Reduction). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. There is established within the United States Geological Survey a post-earthquake investigations program, the purpose of which is to investigate major earthquakes, so as to learn lessons which can be applied to reduce the loss of lives and property in future earthquakes.
